description.value: Mogiana Coffee is a family-heritage specialty coffee roaster founded in 2008 by Cristina Dias, sourcing beans directly from her family's farm in the Mogiana region of Brazil — a tradition spanning five generations since the 1890s. The Burnaby roastery sells small-batch, roasted-to-order beans direct to the public and operates a regular circuit of Vancouver-area farmers markets. Cyclists can purchase whole-bean coffee on-site at the roastery, though calling ahead is recommended to ensure staff are available.
